segments.text: Bhai, suno! Tata Nexon ki power kitni hai? 81 kW! Kya bolti hai public?
Aur engine? 1.5-litre ka solid engine, aur torque bhi 245 N⋅m! Kya yeh sab milke Nexon ko ek beast bana dete hain?
Tez bhi hai, 9.9 seconds mein 0-100! Road par chalao, dikhao apni speed!

Ab value for money variant ki baat karein to Creative variant best hai! Jisme 360-degree camera, automatic climate control, alloy wheels aur cruise control, sab kuch hai! Paisa-vasool to hai, lekin aapke budget mein bhi fit hai?
Aur jo log abhi tak Nexon nahi liye hai, unke liye ek hi sawal - iske aage tumhari gaadi khadi ho, toh log poochte hain — ye chalti bhi hai?
Toh bhai, aapki gaadi kitni paisa-vasool hai? Follow karo, mast car content dekho, aur apni gaadi ke baare mein humse baat karo! Kya aap ready ho?
